qualification: Owned index preparation and native/persistent correctness milestone. Full architecture and end-to-end performance qualification remain incomplete.
implemented: Owned immutable index preparation, exact deletion revision validation and replacement building after writer shutdown.
Finite native namespace preparation read sets release broad data epochs before replacement CPU work.
C API batch preparation releases its current-runtime admission guard before private replacement construction.
Prepared native aliases work after original backend teardown; resident and large sources retain their actual accounting owners.
Exact physical source pooling supports construction and numerical aliases without trusting alias names.
Linear coalesced-effect and authoritative-ordinal overlay validation.
Loaded namespace witnesses reject stale snapshots and authenticate compaction inode rebasing; prepared hosts retain exact inode checks.
durability_contract: Real foreground insert, overwrite and delete tests assert one native checkpoint; the durable variant asserts one sync, including dynamic claims across two text indexes. This is an operation-count contract, not an end-to-end performance result.

earlier_full_local_gate.failure: The 32-handle issue1015 test returned invalid_argument once. The native error detail was not captured; its cause is not established.

remaining_capi_qualification.isolated_rechecks: The existing candidate test passed under the debugger, and a freshly compiled diagnostic candidate passed. Per-worker operation and native-error diagnostics remain in the regression. These checks predate this milestone and do not replace a final full C API gate.

outstanding: Late-bound actual replay progress and exact committed source-tip admission witnesses.
Independent bounded staging and publication service, with requests queued before writer admission.
Compatible same-index group commit, individual logical outcomes and receipts, and owned SQL/transform readsets.
Durable normalized posting-delta windows and query-visible hot tails, freezing by bounded byte/document limits rather than RPC boundaries.
Native reclamation progress independent of stale index runtimes; remaining retention and accounting audits.
Final coherent library, full C API/SDK/ABI/crash gates, unchanged original-importer comparisons, and optimized wolfspider qualification using existing references.
Full factory remains owned by the Beads task; aggregate repository CI remains separately required.

retention.policy: Only closed obsolete task-local test executable/object directories older than thirty minutes were removed. Reference binaries, installed libraries, frozen inputs and databases were preserved. No per-run database archive was created.
